title: Preventive Maintenance of Road: Asphalt Overlay, Barotac Viejo, Sn Rafael RD

colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.
contractor: A.D. Pendon Construction & Supply, Inc. (winning bidder)

reasons.title: A bidder has a reported link to an official or investigation
reasons.detail: IBC INTERNATIONAL BUILDERS CORPORATION: documented link to James "Jojo" Ang Jr. (House representative, Uswag Ilonggo party-list): ICI and DPWH recommended criminal and administrative cases to the Ombudsman against eight lawmakers whose or whose families' firms won DPWH contracts (about 1,300 projects, 2016-20 [recommended, 2025-11-26; as reported]
reasons.evidence: From the team's register of company–person links reported in the news or hearings. Reported, not proven.
checks: Read the source article; confirm the link is stated there, not inferred.
Look for an official document (SEC filing, COA report, Ombudsman complaint) that confirms it.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: A.D. Pendon Construction & Supply, Inc. (winner): 1 of 191 earlier road contracts terminated; F. Gurrea Construction, Incorporated: 1 of 100 earlier road contracts terminated; Ibc International Builders Corporation: 8 of 453 earlier road contracts terminated; Sargasso Construction & Development Corp.: 3 of 14 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

reasons.title: The winner's other projects drew citizen reports
reasons.detail: A.D. PENDON CONSTRUCTION & SUPPLY, INC. (FORMERLY: ADP CONSTRUCTION & SUPPLY) has 5 other DPWH projects reported by citizens (ghost/defective/unfinished tags)
reasons.evidence: A contractor whose other roads drew 2+ citizen reports had about 4.5 times the odds of a report.
checks: Open the winner's reported projects on the DPWH Transparency Portal and read what citizens reported.
Plan a site visit or ask a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, TAPAT) to look once work starts.

reasons.title: Citizen inspectors rated the winner's other work unsatisfactory
reasons.detail: A.D. PENDON CONSTRUCTION & SUPPLY, INC. (FORMERLY: ADP CONSTRUCTION & SUPPLY) has 3 project(s) rated unsatisfactory by Bisto citizen site inspectors
more: A.D. PENDON CONSTRUCTION & SUPPLY, INC. (FORMERLY: ADP CONSTRUCTION & SUPPLY) has 3 project(s) rated unsatisfactory by Bisto citizen site inspectors

checks: Open the inspections of the winner's other projects on bisto.ph.
